title: Best Design Consultants (2026): Expert Feedback on Your Design
description: How to hire a design consultant for expert feedback on branding, websites, packaging or decks: format, deliverables, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Design consultants give expert feedback and advice on your visual work: a logo, website, app, packaging, pitch deck or brand system. A consultation can help you decide what to fix, what to keep and what to brief a designer next. Good consultations are specific, honest and focused on your goals. They go wrong when feedback is vague, based only on personal taste, or not connected to what your audience needs. This guide helps you get design advice you can act on.

faq.q: What happens in a design consultation?
faq.a: Usually a review of your materials, a call or written report, and specific recommendations.

faq.q: Will the consultant redesign my work?
faq.a: Usually not. Consultation focuses on advice. Redesign is a separate project.

faq.q: How specific will the advice be?
faq.a: It should be very specific: what to change, why and in what order.
